PY=../assets-pack/.venv/bin/python   # the assets-pack venv; web/node_modules, web/vendor and web/pack link to the assets-pack install
scripts/build_all.sh [id ...]         # every id (rocks2.MODELS) -> work/build/<id>_lod{0,1,2}.glb + <id>.json, one process per id (deterministic)
$PY scripts/lineup.py [set ...]       # each set lined up on its stage, toon-lit -> work/look/set_<set>.jpg while iterating
$PY scripts/look.py <id> ...          # per-model views while iterating -> work/look/<id>.jpg
